readme:
# FA_RTL

Flash Attention accelerator RTL baseline project. The repository keeps the
hardware implementation, fixed-point golden model, simulation flow, synthesis
flow, and design documentation in one place.

## Directory Map

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `rtl/` | Synthesizable RTL for control, DMA, buffers, compute core, VPU, and top-level integration. |
| `verification/tb/` | Archived Verilog/SystemVerilog testbenches, grouped by `unit/`, `integration/`, `smoke/`, and `debug/`. |
| `verification/sim/` | Simulation Makefile, filelists, golden comparison scripts, and generated simulation outputs. |
| `model/` | Python fixed-point FlashAttention golden model, configs, tests, and vector generation tools. |
| `syn/` | Cadence Genus synthesis and VPU timing-analysis scripts. |
| `docs/` | Architecture notes, unit specs, diagrams, and presentation material. |
| `CONTEXT.md` | Project domain language for Flash Attention dataflow and module responsibilities. |

## Quick Verification

The main end-to-end regression is `tb_fa_integration`:

```powershell
cd verification/sim
make win-xsim TEST=fa_integration
```

A clean run prints:

```text
tb_fa_integration: PASS
Golden compare PASS
```

The golden comparison checks `SCORE`, `P`, `PV`, and `O` streams against the
Python fixed-point model. See `verification/sim/README.md` for the full simulation flow.

## Common Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cd verification/sim; make win-xsim TEST=fa_integration` | Run the Windows Vivado xsim integration regression. |
| `cd verification/sim; make cad-run TEST=fa_integration` | Run the Linux Xcelium integration regression. |
| `cd verification/sim; make list-tests` | List supported simulation tests. |
| `cd verification/sim; make clean` | Remove simulator-generated files for the active platform. |
| `cd model; python run_experiment.py --config configs/baseline.json` | Generate fixed-point model debug outputs for the RTL-aligned baseline. |
| `cd model; python -m pytest -q` | Run Python model tests. |
| `cd syn; make logic` | Run logical Genus synthesis for `TOP`. |
| `cd syn; make ispatial CLK_PERIOD=5.0` | Run physical-aware iSpatial synthesis for `TOP`. |

## Generated Artifacts

Build products, simulator outputs, generated vectors, model debug logs, and
synthesis reports are not tracked. Important generated paths include:

```text
out/
verification/sim/results/
model/debug_logs/
model/vectors/
model/sweep_results/
syn/log/
syn/report/
syn/database/
xsim.dir/
*.log
*.pb
```

If a verification run recreates these files, they should stay ignored by Git.
Do not commit generated outputs unless the project explicitly promotes one to a
checked-in fixture.

## Refactor Plan

Directory cleanup should stay incremental so Git history remains easy to follow:

1. Keep generated artifacts out of version control.
2. Fix stale filelists and path drift before moving source files.
3. Move RTL directories by hardware responsibility, with path-only commits where possible.
4. Consolidate testbenches, simulation entrypoints, and comparison tools into a verification area.
5. Move model configs under a dedicated configs directory and update docs after each path change.

Run `tb_fa_integration` after every repository layout change.
